name: traveler-v1
chrf_floor_note: Calibrated from the NEU-61 kickoff sweep: measured corpus chrF 80.6 on the published v2.0.0 pack; floor = max(15.0, min(0.45 * chrF, chrF - 20)). A direction-mislabeled pack collapses far below this value (see the es-en adversarial control).

entries.source: Jeg skal bruge 3 billetter til i morgen formiddag.
entries.reference: I need 3 tickets for tomorrow morning.

entries.source: Vi er 5 personer, herunder 2 børn.
entries.reference: There are 5 of us, including 2 children.

entries.source: Mit telefonnummer er 0044 7788 123456.
entries.reference: My phone number is 0044 7788 123456.

entries.source: Flyveturen tager 9 timer og 25 minutter.
entries.reference: The flight takes 9 hours and 25 minutes.

entries.source: Vi er 4 personer og har 6 kufferter.
entries.reference: We are 4 people and we have 6 suitcases.

entries.source: Værelse 214 ligger på anden sal.
entries.reference: Room 214 is on the second floor.

entries.source: Jeg ankom den 3. oktober og rejser den 9. oktober.
entries.reference: I arrived on October 3 and I leave on October 9.

entries.source: Hvornår åbner museet om søndagen?
entries.reference: What time does the museum open on Sundays?

entries.source: Mit tog afgår klokken 18:45 fra spor 7.
entries.reference: My train leaves at 18:45 from platform 7.

entries.source: Den sidste bus afgår klokken 23:30 i aften.
entries.reference: The last bus leaves at 23:30 tonight.

entries.source: Jeg har en reservation klokken 20 for 2 personer.
entries.reference: I have a reservation at 8 pm for 2 people.

entries.source: Åbner apoteket før klokken 9 om morgenen?
entries.reference: Does the pharmacy open before 9 in the morning?

entries.source: Turen starter klokken 14:15 og varer 3 timer.
entries.reference: The tour starts at 14:15 and lasts 3 hours.

entries.source: Morgenmad serveres fra 6:30 til 10:00.
entries.reference: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00.

entries.source: Hvad koster et dobbeltværelse for 3 nætter?
entries.reference: How much is a double room for 3 nights?

entries.source: Det koster 45 euro, inklusive moms.
entries.reference: This costs 45 euros, including tax.

entries.source: Er der rabat for 2 voksne og 1 barn?
entries.reference: Is there a discount for 2 adults and 1 child?

entries.source: Billetten koster 12,50 euro pr. person.
entries.reference: The ticket costs 12.50 euros per person.

entries.source: Kan jeg betale de 78 euro med kort?
entries.reference: Can I pay the 78 euros by card?

entries.source: Hvad koster lufthavnsbussen for 2 personer?
entries.reference: How much is the airport shuttle for 2 people?

entries.source: Dagens menu koster 15 euro inklusive en drik.
entries.reference: The menu of the day is 15 euros with a drink included.

entries.source: Adressen er Calle Mayor 15, tredje sal.
entries.reference: The address is Calle Mayor 15, third floor.

entries.source: Mit hotel ligger på Gran Vía 28, tæt på metroen.
entries.reference: My hotel is at 28 Gran Vía, near the metro.

entries.source: Ambassaden ligger på Paseo de la Castellana 259.
entries.reference: The embassy is at Paseo de la Castellana 259.

entries.source: Skriv venligst adressen ned: nummer 42, lejlighed 5B.
entries.reference: Please write down the address: number 42, apartment 5B.

entries.source: Mødestedet er Plaza del Sol, port 3.
entries.reference: The meeting point is Plaza del Sol, gate 3.

entries.source: Er dette vejen til Carrer de Balmes 112?
entries.reference: Is this the way to Carrer de Balmes 112?

entries.source: Hvor er den nærmeste busstoppested?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest bus stop?

entries.source: Drej til venstre ved lyskrydset og gå derefter ligeud 200 meter.
entries.reference: Turn left at the traffic lights, then go straight for 200 meters.

entries.source: Kan man gå fra stationen til hotellet?
entries.reference: Is the station within walking distance of the hotel?

entries.source: Hvilken linje kører til lufthavnen, linje 5 eller linje 8?
entries.reference: Which line goes to the airport, line 5 or line 8?

entries.source: Undskyld, er dette plads 14A?
entries.reference: Excuse me, is this seat 14A?

entries.source: Hvordan kommer jeg til den gamle bydel herfra?
entries.reference: How do I get to the old town from here?

entries.source: Museet ligger cirka 15 minutters gang fra pladsen.
entries.reference: The museum is about 15 minutes on foot from the square.

entries.source: Ring venligst efter en ambulance, en person er bevidstløs.
entries.reference: Please call an ambulance, someone is unconscious.

entries.source: Jeg har mistet mit pas og min pung.
entries.reference: I have lost my passport and my wallet.

entries.source: Hvor er det nærmeste hospital eller klinik?
entries.reference: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?

entries.source: Jeg er allergisk over for peanuts; indeholder denne ret nogen?
entries.reference: I am allergic to peanuts; does this dish contain any?

entries.source: Nogen stjal min taske med 200 euro i.
entries.reference: Someone stole my bag with 200 euros inside.

entries.source: Ring til politiet, tak. Der er sket en ulykke.
entries.reference: Call the police, please. There has been an accident.
